content.comment_body: I'm supporting a friend with their irrigation system on a farm and want to use a pressure transmitter connected to an [article_no] device with an AM2 module. When reviewing the manual for the [product_name], it mentions that the maximum distance for the analog 4-20mA input on the AM module is 10 meters, which appears short compared to information from other PLC forums. Is this specified length correct, or is [company_name] being extra cautious? Or is there something unique in these controllers that prevents longer cable runs compared to standard PLCs?

The 4-20mA signal is considered robust, offering strong resistance to interference and no voltage drop. With properly shielded cables, I would feel comfortable using much greater lengths than the 10 meters suggested by [company_name]. I believe even lengths over 100 meters should not pose issues if the cable shielding is installed correctly. Where did you see the maximum length of 10 meters? I can only find reference to a 10-meter maximum for the AM2-RTD unit when used with PT100/1000 sensors.

On page 309 of the US English [product_name][article_no] technical manual, within the AM2 module specifications, it states: "Line length (shielded and twisted) Max. 10 m." Could this be a mistake and should actually be 100 meters?

Two years ago, I installed two sensors for level measurement using 4-20mA signals with cable lengths around 165 meters. There were no issues encountered, although this installation was not done with [product_name].

analysis.insight_summary: Forum users are concerned about the official specification of a 10-meter maximum cable length for the 4-20mA analog input on the AM2 module in the [product_name] system. Some feel this limitation may be too conservative, given that robust signals like 4-20mA typically support much longer cable runs in industrial settings. There is uncertainty whether this limit is due to specific product design or an error in the documentation, and users are seeking clarification to avoid installation problems.
analysis.user_expectations: Users anticipate the product should allow for longer analog signal cable lengths, consistent with widely accepted industry practices and comparable PLCs. They expect clear, accurate documentation detailing installation restrictions and real-world capabilities.
